location_exception_reason: Portable Shelters are manufactured commodities with pan-India supply capability and no GI-tagged or origin-defined variants. Location in title (e.g., 'Faridabad Portable Shelter') is seller geography, not a product attribute affecting buyer choice.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'Supplier', 'Dealer') are redundant in titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'Portable Shelter Manufacturer' leaves a complete product description.
